integrity.proof_basis: explicit group-action argument and established unary result

scientific_limitations: The new result is the exact binary alphabet threshold, not a new unrestricted output spectrum.
The result concerns complete deterministic permutation automata and right quotient; no minimal total-state bound or left quotient result is claimed.
The symbolic proof uses the published unary interval theorem; finite checks alone do not establish any universal statement.
Possible unindexed equivalent binary constructions remain an originality risk.
title: Two letters suffice for the full accepting-state spectrum of permutation right quotients
